races.paceDynamic: Ade Boy, Tread Carefully, and Destination Unkown will forge a strong gallop from the outset, with three confirmed front runners ensuring a genuine test of stamina over this staying trip. The pace will be relentless early with these leaders fighting for position, likely stringing out the field and creating gaps. With Destination Unkown carrying a fading tendency and both other leaders needing to prove stamina credentials, the sustained pace will set up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses. This race shape strongly favours the patient, hold-up style runners who can deliver their challenge late when the early pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three front runners maintain a fierce gallop through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The strong early pace will take its toll on Ade Boy, Tread Carefully and Destination Unkown, allowing the patient hold-up runners to sweep past in the final furlong. Emerald Breeze and Pertemps are ideally positioned to capitalize on this collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If Ade Boy or Tread Carefully can dictate a more measured pace than expected
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters manages their effort better and kicks clear when the others fold, holding off the late challengers. Recent winner Ade Boy has shown the stamina to last home at this trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy scramble finish
scenarios.trigger: If Destination Unkown's fading tendency disrupts the early pace-setting
scenarios.body: The uneven gallop creates a tactical affair where positioning becomes crucial in the straight. The more experienced campaigners who can adapt to the changing pace dynamics will prevail.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider benefits from chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: Exiguus, despite his lower rating, finds himself perfectly placed as the higher-rated horses neutralize each other. His hold-up style allows him to pick up the pieces when others stop.

races.paceDynamic: De Deli Counter and Perfect Arch will dispute the early lead, with both possessing confirmed front-running styles that should ensure an honest gallop from the outset. The presence of two genuine pace-setters means the early tempo will be solid rather than crawling, creating a true test over this stamina-sapping trip. With most of the field adopting hold-up tactics, there's a clear split between early leaders and back-markers, leaving few horses to fill the mid-division gaps. This race shape strongly favours the prominent racers who can sit just off the pace-setters without getting drawn into their early battle, positioning them perfectly to strike when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If De Deli Counter and Perfect Arch set sensible fractions without burning each other out early
scenarios.body: The honest gallop perfectly sets up horses like By The Grace and Lemon Leaf who can track the pace without pressure. Their prominent styles avoid both the early speed battle and the traffic problems that will engulf the hold-up horses in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges Late
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders go too fast early and create a strong pace collapse scenario
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop stretches the field and allows a classy closer to weave through tired horses in the final furlong. Quality hold-up performers like Gms Prince can exploit their superior RPR ratings when others have shot their bolt.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If either De Deli Counter or Perfect Arch gets an uncontested lead through smart jockeyship
scenarios.body: Without serious pressure, the leader conserves energy and proves hard to peg back up the hill. De Deli Counter's superior rating and recent third at this trip makes him the more likely survivor of the two pace-setters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders tie up dramatically and the prominent horses also get caught in the battle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with mid-division hold-up horses inheriting a race that falls apart. Horses like Fine As Wine or Times A Wastin could benefit from the carnage despite their recent poor form.

races.paceDynamic: Achille Des Rocs will control the tempo from the front with Ballynaheer and Rodney Bay sitting prominently behind, while Dangerous Touch drops in last as the only confirmed hold-up horse. With just four runners and one clear pacesetter, this creates a moderate tempo that won't stretch the field early. The lack of pace pressure means Achille Des Rocs can dictate terms and potentially steal a march, while the prominent runners can track without stress. This tactical setup clearly favours the front-running and prominent styles over hold-up tactics, as Dangerous Touch will have limited pace to aim at in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Achille Des Rocs maintains a steady tempo without being pressured early.
scenarios.body: The pacesetter gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear before the prominent runners can respond effectively. This scenario rewards the horse that can control the race from pillar to post.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Ballynaheer or Rodney Bay track the leader closely and time their challenge perfectly.
scenarios.body: The prominent runners benefit from following the pace before delivering a well-timed challenge in the final half-mile. Their positioning allows them to respond quickly when the pacesetter comes under pressure.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Rallies
scenarios.trigger: If Dangerous Touch finds enough pace to aim at despite the modest tempo.
scenarios.body: The hold-up horse uses superior finishing speed to overhaul the leaders despite the tactical disadvantage. This requires the front-runners to come back to them in the final stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If all the front-runners tie up due to early tactical battles or stamina failures.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a war of attrition where tactical positioning matters less than pure stamina and finishing kick. The horse with the most energy left wins regardless of early tactics.

watchPoints.text: Achille Des Rocs showing any signs of rustiness early given the 348-day absence, which could completely undermine the front-running tactics.
Rodney Bay beginning to struggle from the second-last fence onwards as his known finishing fade could eliminate him despite good positioning.

Ballynaheer's positioning turning for home, as the prominent runner with best recent form could be perfectly placed to strike.
The overall tempo through the first mile, as a genuine test will suit stamina types while a crawling pace favours pure speed.

races.paceDynamic: Gower Prince provides the only confirmed pace-setting threat in this 8-runner field, likely to get an uncontested lead with Beat The Edge and Forsa Bay sitting prominent but not pressuring early. The sustainable tempo will allow the front-runner to dictate terms through the middle sections, creating a tactical race where positioning matters more than raw pace pressure. With six hold-up horses crowding the rear, traffic problems are inevitable in the home straight as they all seek racing room simultaneously. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure clean positions early and avoid the scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Gower Prince jumps cleanly and gets an easy lead without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The O'Neill runner can measure his fractions perfectly and has enough class at OR 99 to repel late challenges. Six hold-up horses create a bunched finish behind him but none can make up the ground against his tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Beat The Edge or Forsa Bay can sit close enough to Gower Prince while staying out of trouble
scenarios.body: Hammond's improving yard form (3/24) gives Beat The Edge the tactical edge from a prominent position, while Forsa Bay's recent third at Market Rasen shows current form. Both avoid the hold-up cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or one hold-up horse gets a clear run through
scenarios.body: Cawthorne Cracker's excellent going record (2W5P on good) and long absence could produce a fresh performance if finding room. The Greenall/Guerriero team know how to place one despite poor recent strike rate.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Suits Finisher
scenarios.trigger: If Gower Prince stops quickly and the prominent runners fade, creating a slow overall time
scenarios.body: The entire complexion changes with hold-up horses suddenly advantaged by a tactical finish. Starman's RPR 108 and recent placed efforts suggest he's the pick of the back-markers if this unfolds.

races.paceDynamic: Hijo De La Luna and Ruler Legend are the natural pace-setters in a field dominated by hold-up horses, with Cawthorne Banker likely tracking prominently. With seven of nine runners preferring to be held up (Kalkaroo, Bouboule, Diesel Line, Bunker Bay, Macho Sun, Susiesparkle), this creates a tactical bottleneck where positioning and timing become critical. The modest early pace set by Hijo De La Luna should create a searching test from the last hurdle as the field compresses. This race shape strongly favours the prominent racers and those hold-up horses with proven tactical speed, as they can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the back-markers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Pairs Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Hijo De La Luna and Ruler Legend maintain sensible fractions without going too fast early
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade get caught in traffic as the pace quickens from the last hurdle, allowing the early positioned horses to kick clear. Cawthorne Banker's prominent style and O'Neill stable form gives him the edge over the front-running Hijo De La Luna.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too steady and the field remains tightly bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: A patient hold-up horse with tactical speed can weave through and time their challenge perfectly. Kalkaroo's class edge and Twiston-Davies partnership becomes decisive, while Diesel Line's proven course form at this trip pays dividends.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Hijo De La Luna gets an uncontested lead and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: The patient tactics backfire as the leader gets first run and stays on strongly up the hill. Hijo De La Luna's stamina-laden pedigree and fresh legs after 289 days off prove the winning combination.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and it becomes a sprint finish from the last hurdle
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses with the best finishing kick and least weight get home in a bunch finish. Bouboule's higher topspeed rating and light weight of 155lbs sees him flash home late.
